# antares

> antares is a spec-driven project whose validated source of truth lives in doc/arch; specs come first and code follows.

spec-first: doc/arch is the source of truth — run `speckit status` then `speckit next` and read the spec before writing any code.

## Documentation

- [Agent context](AGENTS.md): dense LLM context
- [Human overview](README.md): approachable overview
- [Spec corpus](doc/arch/): the validated source of truth

## Specs

- [001 kernel-io-engine-kqueue](doc/arch/sdd/001-kernel-io-engine-kqueue/spec.md)
- [002 http-client-h2](doc/arch/sdd/002-http-client-h2/spec.md)

## Layers, contracts and configuration

Layers inward: `domain`, `application`, `ports`, `adapters`; `src/platform` is
the only OS root. Kernel I/O goes through the `IoEngine` port; kqueue is the
engine and `poll` the fallback. Language mode is C++26 with CMake 4.4 as the
floor. Durations are `std::chrono`, instants are `steady_clock::time_point`, byte
counts are the `Bytes` value type; nothing re-wraps what the standard library
already gives. Exit codes are stable 0-8; `--json` emits one object.

Binary artifacts stay out of the tree: everything under `build/` is regenerated.
HTTP/2 client: OpenSSL 3 for TLS, nghttp2 for framing, our connection and redirect
policy on the engine; `ClientConfig` publishes pool, timeouts and auth.
